translated_title: Disappearances of Persons in Mexico City Drop 30 Percent; Locations Rise 68 Percent, Brugada Says
original_title: Disminuye 30 por ciento desaparición de personas en CDMX; localización sube 68 por ciento, afirma Brugada
author: Darren García
meta_description: Most cases turn out to be voluntary absences rather than crimes, and 460 million pesos now fund round-the-clock search centers and new specialized agents.
